sloka: बद्ध अंजलि पुटाः सर्वे ये स्युः स्त्री दर्शन क्षमाः ।तान् उवाच ततः प्राप्तान् राजा अर्क सदृश प्रभः ॥४-३८-८॥
transliteration: baddha aṁjali puṭāḥ sarve ye syuḥ strī darśana kṣamāḥ ।tān uvāca tataḥ prāptān rājā arka sadṛśa prabhaḥ ॥4-38-8॥

translations.english: Then seeing the monkeys who had come there, king Sugriva who was shining like the Sungod asked them to get a palanquin ready at once.
